title: National Home for Disabled Volunteer Soldiers, Central Branch, House, 4100 West Third Street, Dayton, Montgomery County, OH
notes: Significance: One of only two single residences remaining at the Soldiers' National Home, this house is an eclectic composition combining Shingle Style, Queen Anne and Tudor features, but has been altered.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 03001412
